overview: You looked at the three sheets and added nothing. They stayed on the board. You did not put them in the coffer. The prison was not begun, and the end was not begun. A crowd was not on the page.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked at the three sheets and left them on the board.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Left the sheets where they were

important_dates.meaning: Three sheets, still on the board

summary: Left the sheets where they were
